To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the GLM-GC technique can detect the changes in the ensemble connectivity during BMI learning.
the GLM-GC framework can detect causal changes in a deafferentated brain, and that these changes can occur due to BMI learning.
“GLM-GC technique is capable of identifying causal networks in a deafferent brain region exposed to a BMI learning task, and the causal network is capable of adapting to the BMI learning task.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the changes that occur in the dynamics of deafferented brain regions, when exposed to BMI learning.
the causal dynamics in the deafferented brain and how the dynamics are altered during BMI learning.
understanding the causal dynamics of neural ensembles in a deafferentated primate brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the causal network in a de-afferented brain can change due to BMI learning.
BMI learning in deafferented motor cortex results in changes in causal networks.
the causal network of a deafferented motor cortical region changes significantly with BMI learning, and the changes in the network dynamics are consistent with the behavioral learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the causal network is dynamic and the causal changes are related to the learning of BMI control.
the causal network of the motor cortex is altered in a BMI learning context, and this change is associated with a change in the dynamics.
the GLM-GC technique is able to detect causal changes in the deafferented brain, which is a novel result.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BMI training leads to emergence of causal networks, and the causal network is not the same as the functional connectivity network.
BMI learning can induce changes in the causal connectivity of the ensemble and these changes are not random but are directed towards a more efficient control.
causal networks can emerge in a deafferent brain region when interfaced to a BMI and that this causal network can change with learning.
